question: Should ID-only Skill Workshop approval requests automatically bind to the proposal version current when the approval prompt is created?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but automatic binding intentionally changes the concurrent-revision outcome of an existing approval flow and establishes a permanent model-facing and CLI lifecycle contract.

options.title: Accept after live proof
options.body: Keep automatic binding with ID-only direct-call compatibility after a real flow demonstrates normal approval and stale-version rejection.

options.title: Use explicit binding only
options.body: Retain optional caller-supplied proposal versions but stop the approval hook from rewriting legacy ID-only requests.

options.title: Land preview separately
options.body: Keep the read-only review action and defer lifecycle version binding to separately approved work.

recommendation.title: Accept after live proof
recommendation.body: Keep automatic binding with ID-only direct-call compatibility after a real flow demonstrates normal approval and stale-version rejection.

likelyOwner.reason: The history most strongly connects Shakker to the original Workshop runtime policy, lifecycle semantics, inspection behavior, serialization, and filesystem safety boundaries affected by this choice.
